questions.question: What did Master Tengen do during the Nara Period?
questions.subject: Tengen/Synopsis

answer.item: During the Nara Period, Master Tengen spread Japanese Buddhism and preached what would become the foundation for jujutsu sorcerers.

questions.question: Why must Tengen merge with a Star Plasma Vessel every 500 years?
questions.subject: Tengen/Synopsis

answer.item: To prevent this, every 500 years, Tengen must merge with a compatible Star Plasma Vessel to rewrite her body's information.

questions.question: What is Kenjaku's objective in the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Tengen/Synopsis

answer.item: Tengen explains Kenjaku's objective: to force the evolution of humankind throughout Japan.

questions.question: How did Kenjaku's fight with Tengen end?
questions.subject: Tengen/Synopsis

answer.item: As Kenjaku undoes the seal on the tree and reveals Tengen's true form, he says goodbye to an old friend.

questions.question: Why did Gakuganji preserve Sukuna's remains?
questions.subject: Tengen/Synopsis

answer.item: Yoshinobu Gakuganji opted to preserve Sukuna's remains in order to keep up Tengen's barriers around Japan for the time being until countermeasures and alternatives could be found.
